employers.description: 23andMe offers direct-to-consumer DNA testing kits that deliver ancestry breakdowns across 4,500+ regions, genetic health risk reports (FDA-cleared), and pharmacogenetic insights through its subscription tiers (23andMe+ Premium and Total Health). The company also runs an opt-in genetic research program and provides exome sequencing with telehealth-coordinated clinical review. In July 2025, its assets were acquired out of Chapter 11 bankruptcy by TTAM Research Institute, a nonprofit founded by former CEO Anne Wojcicki; the consumer brand and services continue to operate under that new ownership.
employers.name: 23ANDME

employers.description: Monogram Biosciences operates a CAP/CLIA-accredited clinical reference laboratory in South San Francisco specializing in HIV molecular diagnostics, including its Trofile viral tropism assay (the companion diagnostic for the CCR5-class drug Selzentry) and PhenoSense drug-resistance testing panels. The lab also supports pharmaceutical companies developing antiviral and oncology therapeutics, providing resistance characterization libraries, validated datasets for NDA submissions, and clinical trial design consultation. The facility employs laboratory scientists, clinical virologists, and bioinformatics staff focused on personalized infectious-disease treatment guidance.
employers.name: Monogram Biosciences

employers.description: Evidation operates a real-world evidence platform that collects continuous, multimodal health data — including wearables, patient-reported outcomes, EHR, and claims — from a consented network of five million participants across the U.S. The company runs longitudinal studies across 20+ condition-specific cohorts (cardiometabolic, autoimmune, dermatology) and has partnered with 90% of top biopharma companies to support drug development and outcomes research. Technical roles span data engineering, clinical informatics, and machine learning applied to health signal processing.
employers.name: Evidation Health

employers.description: Genomic Health was a Redwood City, CA-based molecular diagnostics company best known for its Oncotype DX line of genomic tests, which assess the likelihood of cancer recurrence and guide chemotherapy decisions for breast, colon, and prostate cancer patients. The company was acquired by Exact Sciences Corporation in 2019 and absorbed into its Precision Oncology division; its products continue under the Exact Sciences brand but Genomic Health no longer operates as an independent entity.
employers.name: Genomic Health

employers.description: Health Plan of San Mateo (HPSM) is a county-organized managed care plan serving more than 120,000 Medi-Cal members and dual-eligible residents in San Mateo County through programs including Medi-Cal, CareAdvantage (for Medicare-Medi-Cal dual-eligible members), and HealthWorx HMO. HPSM administers covered benefits such as dental, prescription drugs, mental health services, and non-emergency medical transportation. The organization employs care coordination, utilization management, and administrative staff locally in San Mateo County.
employers.name: Health Plan of San Mateo

employers.description: Illumina Ventures is an independently managed venture capital firm specializing in genomics and precision health, with a strategic relationship to Illumina Inc. (NASDAQ: ILMN). The firm invests at the early stage across life sciences tools, diagnostics, therapeutics, digital health, and sustainability, with portfolio companies including RedShiftBio, Fluent Biosciences, Arbor (gene editing), and Iambic (AI-discovered therapeutics). Through its Illumina Ventures Labs program, it provides portfolio startups with capital, sequencing access, mentorship, and genomics lab capabilities.
employers.name: Illumina Ventures

employers.description: Dignity Health - Sequoia Hospital is a not-for-profit acute-care community hospital in Redwood City, CA, part of the CommonSpirit Health system, serving the greater Bay Area since 1950. The hospital operates over 200 beds and is best known for its Heart and Vascular Institute — a nationally recognized cardiac program with a clinical partnership with Stanford Health Care — along with a Family Birth Center (with Lucile Packard NICU support), orthopedic joint replacement, and a 24-hour emergency department. Clinical and allied health roles on-site include nursing, cardiovascular technologists, surgical technicians, radiology techs, and laboratory scientists.
employers.name: Sequoia Hospital

employers.description: Stanford Blood Center collects whole blood, platelets, plasma, and SuperRed donations to support patients. Operating multiple donation centers across the Bay Area and hosting mobile drives, they also advance transfusion and transplantation medicine through research and specialized products and services.
employers.name: Stanford Blood Center

employers.description: Adicet Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Redwood City, California that develops allogeneic gamma delta CAR T cell therapies for autoimmune diseases and cancer. Its lead program, prulacabtagene leucel (prula-cel), is a Phase 1 off-the-shelf CAR T therapy targeting CD20-expressing B cells across multiple autoimmune conditions including lupus nephritis and systemic sclerosis, with FDA Fast Track Designation for three indications. The company also has an early-stage armored PSMA-targeting program for metastatic prostate cancer, and employs scientists, clinical development staff, and manufacturing operations professionals across its Redwood City headquarters.
employers.name: Adicet Bio

employers.description: Alpha Teknova manufactures high-quality reagents, including buffers, media, and water, for the life sciences industry. They serve over 3,000 customers in academia, biotechnology, and biopharmaceuticals, offering both off-the-shelf and custom formulations from discovery through commercialization in their 180,000 sq ft ISO 13485 certified facilities.
employers.name: Alpha Teknova

employers.description: Alumis is a South San Francisco-based biopharmaceutical company advancing targeted small-molecule therapies for immune-mediated diseases, with a pipeline anchored by envudeucitinib, a selective TYK2 inhibitor in Phase 3 trials for plaque psoriasis and systemic lupus erythematosus. Their pipeline also includes lonigutamab, an anti-IGF-1R antibody targeting thyroid eye disease, and an additional preclinical candidate. The company employs drug discovery, clinical development, and technical operations staff at its Bay Area headquarters.
employers.name: Alumis

employers.description: Anwita Biosciences is a San Carlos-based biopharmaceutical company developing immunotherapy and oncology treatments, with a pipeline built around targeted cytokine fusion proteins (including lead candidate AWT020), antibody-drug conjugates, and multi-specific T-cell engagers. Their platform combines antibody discovery, cytokine engineering, proprietary toxin-linker chemistry, and AI-assisted protein design to target cancers including non-small cell lung cancer, gastrointestinal cancers, and melanoma. The company employs scientists and engineers in protein engineering, computational biology, and oncology drug development at its headquarters in San Carlos, California.
employers.name: Anwita Bioscience

employers.description: AstraZeneca is a research-based biopharmaceutical company focused on transforming healthcare through science. They operate across therapy areas including Oncology, BioPharmaceuticals (Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism, Respiratory & Immunology), Vaccines & Immune Therapies, and Rare Disease, serving people globally.
employers.name: Astrazeneca
